scope: One predeclared four-lane native compiler parse/check cohort: accepted a902 numeric16 baseline, raw-decimal IK-only self-stable C2, raw IK plus typed16 combined candidate, immutable production-main LuaJIT. No standalone typed16 or four-post-check-loop remeasurement.
disposition: Do not integrate either source candidate. Combined/baseline shows directional statistical evidence (95% interval below1), but its interval does not establish the predeclared2% minimum speedup. Raw-only is inconclusive. Retain all unaccepted source, artifacts, samples and outliers; no rerun, CLI gate or broad/pin spend for this cohort.

productComparisons.scope: Different compiler/source/environment versions on this memory-only synthetic production fixture. Not equivalent compiler/backend source, whole-project CLI, or a whole-compiler ratio.

workload: Each fresh process parses/checks the frozen 32-function production fixture 32 times, using a fresh memory-only environment per iteration. Wall time includes process/image or LuaJIT/cache load, module initialization, environment creation, parse/check/GC and checksum. No repeated project I/O inside the driver. Native uses the same interpreted driver over matched AOT compiler bodies.

cohort.orderDesign: Four Williams rows repeated three times; each lane occupies each position three times and each distinct directed adjacent pair occurs three times within rows. The 11 between-row transitions are retained but are not part of the within-row balance.

bootstrap.statistic: geometric mean of 12 paired wall ratios

cohort.outlierPolicy: Keep every preflight, warmup, measured child and raw output. No filtering, retries, or automatic reruns. Verify all native and main inputs before and after every child, outside child wall time. No linear compiled-entry extrapolation.
cohort.quietCoordination: ROOT explicitly confirmed quiet and authorized ONE predeclared four-lane12-pair32-repeat cohort after exact gate verification. Platform/MIR/root are source-only; all32preflight checks passed. Retain all52children with no rerun.
cohort.nativeEntryPolicy: Positive entries checked per child; no linear extrapolation assumption.

sourceOutputIdentityClarification.acceptanceComparisons: All native/reference and baseline/combined comparisons within each preparation gate were exact raw byte equality. No normalization was used to pass a gate.
sourceOutputIdentityClarification.diagnosticOnlyComparison: Historical raw-only baseline output versus new combined-worktree baseline output
sourceOutputIdentityClarification.normalization: For this read-only cross-worktree diagnostic only, replace the single encoded source filename (one byte equal to UTF-8 byte length plus1, then filename bytes) with ASCII PATH. All remaining bytes compare exactly.
sourceOutputIdentityClarification.policy: Prefer the same canonical virtual source name for future cross-worktree emitted-image equality checks.

correctness.fullSelfBroadPinnedDeferred: Not run after unmet practical-performance gate. Existing preparation self-image identity is separate from a full pinned compiler fixpoint.

rawOnly.static: 174 K/IUnbox pairs become IK, with155 IMov;19 fewer instructions before45 new lowering-guard instructions.

combined.scope: Exactly lower/analysis/callfacts composition, frozen before duration; no post-cohort source correction.
combined.staticLimitation: 16 rather than32 of48 new loop IUnbox eliminated; increment remains boxed. No source adjustment.
